title: 28 January 1964: Lennon and Harrison fly to London
content:
To take advantage of The Beatles’ second day off from their 18-night concert residency at the Olympia Theatre, Paris (their first rest day was 21 January), John Lennon and George Harrison flew back to London for an overnight break.

In the evening the two Beatles attended a party held by influential DJ Tony Hall, who lived on Green Street, London. At the party they met Phil Spector and The Ronettes. Harrison and Starr also met Spector on at least one subsequent occasion at Hall’s home.

Page last updated: 24 November 2016

  • 1973: Recording, mixing: Tragedy by Wings
  • 1971: Recording: Uncle Albert/Admiral Halsey, Too Many People by Paul and Linda McCartney; I Lie Around by Wings
  • 1970: Press Conference: Ringo Starr and Peter Sellers in Los Angeles
  • 1970: John Lennon’s Bag One exhibition opens in Long Beach
  • 1969: Allen Klein meets The Beatles
  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day 19
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Majestic Ballroom, Newcastle
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Casbah Coffee Club, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Aintree Institute, Liverpool
